title: Design System: How Long Until — Time Highlighter

title.purpose: Names the extension in the compact popup header.

body.purpose: Baseline popup text; secondary copy is 12px or larger.

label.purpose: Field labels, state notes, and compact supporting text.

countdown.purpose: Primary time-remaining value in the page tooltip; tabular numerals.

shadows.name: toggle-thumb
shadows.purpose: Subtle separation between toggle thumb and track.

shadows.name: active-indicator
shadows.purpose: Quiet halo around the enabled mark.

shadows.name: tooltip-light
shadows.purpose: Separates the event tooltip from page content in light mode.

shadows.name: tooltip-dark
shadows.purpose: Maintains separation over page content in dark mode.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Subtle track and thumb response to a toggle action.

components.name: Main Toggle
components.description: Main enable switch, with a clear active track and keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; width: 44px; height: 26px; padding: 3px; border: 0; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--accent); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease; } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-toggle-thumb { display: block; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px #0003; transform: translateX(18px); transition: transform .15s ease; } .ds-toggle[aria-checked="false"] { background: var(--toggle-muted); } .ds-toggle[aria-checked="false"] .ds-toggle-thumb { transform: translateX(0); } .ds-toggle:disabled { opacity: .46; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Site Toggle
components.description: Smaller per-site version of the same accessible switch.
components.css: .ds-site-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; width: 36px; height: 22px; padding: 3px; border: 0; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--toggle-muted); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease; } .ds-site-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-site-toggle[aria-checked="true"] { background: var(--accent); } .ds-site-toggle-thumb { display: block; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px #0003; transition: transform .15s ease; } .ds-site-toggle[aria-checked="true"] .ds-site-toggle-thumb { transform: translateX(14px); } .ds-site-toggle:disabled { opacity: .46; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Detected Time Row
components.description: Keyboard-accessible page-match row with aligned event countdown.
components.css: .ds-event-row { display: grid; width: 100%; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 4px 8px; padding: 9px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-event-row:hover { background: var(--surface-soft); } .ds-event-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-event-source { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-event-countdown { color: var(--accent-strong); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-event-details { grid-column: 1 / -1; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.45; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-event-row { color: var(--ink-dark); } .ds-event-row:hover { background: var(--surface-soft-dark); } .ds-event-countdown { color: var(--accent-strong-dark); } .ds-event-details { color: var(--muted-dark); } }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Editable zone and override fields with visible keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-text-input { width: 100%; min-height: 31px; padding: 5px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font: inherit; } .ds-text-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-text-input { border-color: var(--line-dark); background: var(--surface-dark); color: var(--ink-dark); } }

components.name: Status Notice
components.html: Website access was not granted. Highlighting remains off.
components.css: .ds-notice { padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface-soft); color: var(--warning); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.45; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-notice { background: var(--surface-soft-dark); color: var(--warning-dark); } }

components.name: Countdown Tooltip
components.description: Floating page detail that leads with time remaining.
components.html:
6 PM CST
in 2 hours
October 21 · 6:00 PM
America/Chicago
Assumed date: October 21
components.css: .ds-tooltip { width: max-content; max-width: min(340px, calc(100vw - 24px)); padding: 13px 16px 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(49, 37, 67, .13); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface); color: #211d27; box-shadow: 0 8px 26px rgba(27,20,38,.15); font: 13px/1.45 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-tooltip-source { color: #625b6d; font-size: 12px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-tooltip-countdown { margin: 2px 0 5px; color: #4e347c; font-size: 25px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.15; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-tooltip-local { color: #211d27; font-size: 13px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-tooltip-zone, .ds-tooltip-assumption { color: #625b6d; font-size: 12px; } .ds-tooltip-assumption { margin-top: 5px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-tooltip { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.16); background: #25212b; color: #f4f0f7; box-shadow: 0 8px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.4); } .ds-tooltip-source, .ds-tooltip-zone, .ds-tooltip-assumption { color: #c2b9cd; } .ds-tooltip-countdown { color: #c8b2f4; } .ds-tooltip-local { color: #f4f0f7; } }

components.name: Page Time Highlight
components.description: Thin violet underline marks the matched range without replacing page text.
components.css: .ds-page-highlight { color: inherit; text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--page-underline); text-decoration-thickness: 1.5px; text-underline-offset: .16em; }

components.name: Reminders Coming Soon
components.description: Muted non-interactive status for the planned Pro feature.
components.css: .ds-coming-soon { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 11px 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; } .ds-coming-soon span:last-child { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }

narrative.northStar: Selected marketing identity: concept 04, a calm blue editorial desk with pale paper, deep navy typography, a restrained cyan time underline, soft daylight, and quiet human context. The utility interface remains the warm-white and violet system currently implemented.
narrative.overview: The utility interface is compact, quiet, readable, and countdown-first. The popup uses warm white surfaces, deep ink, and restrained violet accents. The page keeps its wording and layout; supported times receive a fine violet underline, with details shown in a small floating tooltip. Light and dark appearance follow the operating system. Store marketing follows selected concept 04: a calm blue desk, pale paper, navy typography, a cyan time underline, and soft daylight; its artwork is promotional illustration rather than a product screenshot.
keyCharacteristics: Compact utility surface with a fixed 380px popup width.
System UI typography and tabular countdown numerals.
Warm neutral surfaces, ink text, and violet action/highlight color.
Minimal borders and state feedback; no decorative gradients.
Store marketing follows selected concept 04: pale paper, calm blue, navy type, and a cyan time underline.

rules.name: The Page-Preservation Rule
rules.body: Highlight the detected range with an underline while preserving the original wording and layout.

rules.name: The Readable Utility Rule
rules.body: Keep secondary popup text at 12px or larger and body text at 14px; reserve smaller text for non-user-facing implementation details.

dos: Do preserve the current system UI stack, warm neutral surfaces, restrained violet states, and light/dark role pairing in the utility interface.
Do use the selected concept 04 blue editorial desk, pale paper, navy type, and cyan time underline for store marketing artwork.
Do use the countdown as the page tooltip's strongest typographic element and align changing numbers with tabular numerals.
Do keep focus visible and secondary popup text at least 12px.
Do treat the page underline and tooltip as overlays that leave source text and page structure intact.
donts: Don't apply the store-art blue and cyan palette to the utility interface without a separate UI design change.
Don't add decorative gradients, dashboard-like panels, artificial world clocks, or invented activity to the extension UI.
Don't make the future Reminders label look interactive or claim it is available.
